items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: He used to play with Edmund and all of them up there, you know?

ctx.x: He gives Edmund a good name, yeah. Yeah. Let's see. He's on a record with me.

Yeah, who are? Edmund, yeah. And Rowland, you remember Rowland? That type of person ever that place? Somebody's up the line, not far from, uh. Chicago? Huh? Not far from Chicago? No, no, I mean, not up in the country, yeah. Oh. That's his room. Rowland. Forget you there, son. He's a good trumpet player, too. He used to play with Edmund and all of them up there, you know? Reserve. Reserve? Huh? Up at Reserve? Yeah, Reserve. Yeah, yeah, that's where they're from.
